definitions.explanation: The last day of the year.

examples.japanese: {大晦日|おおみそか}に{年越|としこ}しそばを{食|た}べる。
examples.english: To eat year-crossing soba on New Year's Eve.

examples.japanese: {大晦日|おおみそか}は{紅白|こうはく}を{見|み}る。
examples.english: On New Year's Eve, we watch Kohaku (singing contest).

examples.japanese: {大晦日|おおみそか}の{除夜|じょや}の{鐘|かね}。
examples.english: The temple bells on New Year's Eve.

notes:
CULTURAL:
New Year's Eve customs include:
- {年越|としこ}しそば (toshikoshi soba): eating soba noodles for longevity
- {紅白歌合戦|こうはくうたがっせん} (Kohaku): NHK's annual music show
- {除夜|じょや}の{鐘|かね} (joya no kane): temple bells rung 108 times at midnight
- {大掃除|おおそうじ} (oosouji): year-end cleaning
